presentation.label: MIDI EXPRESSION
presentation.summary: Pitch bend, channel aftertouch and the mod wheel from MIDI IN add to what a MIDI track sends its synth, on the route its notes take.
presentation.overview: Stock, the Digitakt passes the notes of an external keyboard through to the synth a MIDI track plays, but drops pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel. With SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU ticked, those messages follow the notes and are added to the track's own values (its knob, parameter locks and LFO), capped to the MIDI limits: on the AUTO CHANNEL to the active MIDI track, and on a track's own TRACK CHANNEL to that track, on the track's CHAN out of MIDI OUT. Selecting another track gives the previous synth back the track's own values. For live playing: nothing is recorded into the sequencer. Unticked, MIDI handling is stock.
highlights: Play a synth through a MIDI track with pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel.
Adds to the track's LFO and parameter locks instead of fighting them, within the MIDI limits.
Follows the stock AUTO CHANNEL and TRACK CHANNEL routing of the notes; leaving a track restores its own values.
Sequencer notes and controls go out first; three SETTINGS rows; unticked, MIDI is stock.
usage: Connect a keyboard to MIDI IN on the AUTO CHANNEL and a synth to MIDI OUT.
Select a MIDI track, switch its CHAN on and set the synth's channel.
Tick PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU in SETTINGS, then play: bends, pressure and the mod wheel reach the synth.

access.location: SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU, MW THRU
steps: Use a build containing MIDI Expression for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Press SETTINGS and go down to PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU, below SYSTEM, with UP/DOWN.
Press YES to tick or untick a row. RIGHT ticks it and LEFT unticks it.

controls.name: PB THRU
controls.doc: Ticked: pitch bend from MIDI IN is added to the track's own pitch bend (knob, parameter locks, LFO), within 0-16383, and sent on the CHAN of each MIDI track the notes on that channel would play. Unticked: dropped, as stock, and the track's own value is restored. Unticked at every power-on; not saved.

controls.name: AT THRU
controls.doc: Ticked: channel aftertouch is added to the track's own AT, within 0-127, routed like PB THRU. Poly aftertouch is not passed. Unticked: dropped, as stock.

controls.name: MW THRU
controls.doc: Ticked, with PORT CONFIG > RECEIVE CC/NRPN ticked: the mod wheel (CC 1) is added to the track's own MW, within 0-127, routed like PB THRU, after the stock control-change handling. Unticked: CC 1 is handled as stock only.

limitations: Not saved: the three rows start unticked (stock) at every power-on.
Sends to DIN MIDI OUT only, not USB: the stock USB sender is not safe to call from the MIDI input task.
Only MIDI tracks A-H with CHAN on receive; audio tracks ignore pitch bend, as stock.
Not recorded: the sequencer never sees the live values.
A bend can reach the synth a few milliseconds before the note played with it.

load.conditions: Measure under a flood of notes, CC, pitch bend, aftertouch and clock at the wire rate.

tests.summary: Host unit tests (34 checks): sums with the track's own PB/AT/MW, MIDI limits, take-over, release on track change, priority and routing. Emulator (digiemu): pass-through on the notes' route from the auto channel and TRACK CHANNEL; unticked identical to stock; stock CC handling unchanged; beside FX Track and CC Recall. Hardware not yet tested.

license.declaration: Original work by tekomelu. The SETTINGS row follows the row record and OS 1.54 addresses FX Track documents (draadpiraat, GPL-3.0-or-later).
